decision: Rawlsing is framed as an AI neighbor / relational practice environment rather than primarily an AI character-chat product.
reopen_condition: Evidence that the relational-neighbor framing cannot support the core transformative goal or compelling use.

decision: The initial persona should not be selected primarily for preexisting desirability; random/unselected encounter is constitutive of the spiritual product thesis.
reopen_condition: Alpha evidence shows another encounter mechanism preserves the same anti-selection function more effectively.

decision: Attachment, trust, health, pleasure, compliance, intimacy, benefit and dependency must remain distinguishable system variables or concepts.
reopen_condition: A stronger ontology preserves all relevant distinctions with fewer canonical objects.

decision: Relationship advancement should be expressed primarily through changed persona behavior, expectation, access, conflict and reciprocity rather than a visible friendship meter.
reopen_condition: Testing shows carefully exposed state improves learning without converting the person into an optimization target.

decision: Greater intimacy may increase relational difficulty by activating expectations, needs, developmental residues, conflicts and network stakes.
reopen_condition: Psychological research or prototype evidence rejects the assumed mechanism or suggests safer/more accurate forms.

decision: Rawlsing should longitudinally model user relational praxis as observed behavior patterns, not present it as clinical diagnosis.
reopen_condition: A validated and appropriately governed clinical use case is separately established.

decision: LLM expression must not itself define canonical objective world, hidden health or relationship state; admission remains explicit.
reopen_condition: Never by convenience; only a new governed ontology proving equivalence may replace this boundary.

decision: Sorok remains non-dispositive to Pyat until a product conclusion is promoted to ACCEPTED_PRODUCT_REQUIREMENT and crosswalked to exact engineering ownership.
No-avatar is the preferred product direction; identity should emerge through language, time, relationship, memory and behavior rather than visual character embodiment.
reopen_condition: User research demonstrates a non-avatar-violating visual representation materially improves the core experience.

decision: The user controls attempted speech/action/attention, not feasibility, success, reception, meaning or downstream effect.
reopen_condition: A stronger interaction model preserves independent world/person causality without this separation.

decision: Narration is restricted to the user's phenomenally accessible surface and must not reveal or suggest hidden actor psychology through interpretive narration.
reopen_condition: User testing establishes a bounded interpretive affordance that does not violate actor opacity or collapse the inference game.

decision: User mentions do not instantiate world facts; any fact narrated as existing must become canonical persistent world state in the same turn.
reopen_condition: A different persistence mechanism proves equivalent consistency while preserving anti-suggestion and replay.

decision: Rawlsing preserves intention, realized action, objective impact, actor attribution, relationship effect, health effect, downstream consequence and user knowledge as distinct dimensions.
reopen_condition: A smaller ontology is demonstrated to preserve all materially different cases without scalar collapse.

decision: Consequences propagate through the world independently of whether they are ever surfaced as feedback to the user.
reopen_condition: Never by engagement convenience; only an equivalent causal architecture may replace this law.
